{{Top|leg}}
The '''Western Sea''', also known as the '''Endless Sea''', was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] that separated the continents of [[Keshtah Minor]] and [[Alanciar]]. The currents of its [[Water/Legends|waters]] flowed in such a way that travel by [[Boat/Legends|boat]] from Keshtah to Alanciar was nearly impossible.
